patch_description: The key weakness is ranking ~80 softmin gradient-ascent candidates purely by the softmin-derived exact score, then polishing only top-4 — softmin-optimal candidates can be exact-poor near plateaus. This rewrite implements a two-pass funnel: (1) generate ~60 diverse seeds (3-fold symmetric expansions, two-ring hexagons, 7+5 ring, jittered circles, seeded random), (2) cheap 3-step mini exact hill-climb on ALL candidates to re-rank with the true objective, (3) full exact coordinate-descent polish (multi-step, shrinking steps, 8 directions) on the re-ranked top-10, (4) deterministic basin-hopping around the best with re-descend. Key parameters changed: mini-climb re-ranking (steps_max=3, step=0.02) for all candidates; polish slots raised 4→10; polish uses 8 directions with step halving to 1e-5; exact-objective polish only (no blended surrogate ranking). Runtime kept under ~20s by bounding mini-climb work.
